c1_interpretation: Observed baseline denominators from the untreated A+K+ replay. The C1 A- denominator is the count of baseline K-available edges; the K- denominator is the count of baseline A-available edges. The floor is applied per seed and path by a1_result; any value below 60 is a VOID risk. The cell-stream and candidate-stream counts are reported separately because they are not the same edge set.
c4_interpretation: The C4 non-target rows are counted, not scored. Treatment deltas still require the A+K+, A+K-, A-K+ and A-K- cell parts.
not_evidence: A no-arm baseline-availability audit. It runs no A1 cell, freezes no target, makes no causal, capability or transfer claim, and does not measure C1, C4, C7 or C8.
